scope: Four exact source-English row corrections in three printed page ranges; draft translation still awaits specialist review.

rows.note: The surrounding verses describe crossing mountains and a plain; the previous English invented a horse. Будурала is provisionally rendered rugged.

rows.revised_en: A salt-tinged land of wild kulans,
rows.note: The Kyrgyz line describes terrain and kulans. Тузаң is provisionally rendered salt-tinged; its precise lexical sense needs specialist review. The previous English invented the place-name Talas.
Доо names a grievance or dispute; the previous English described a mountain absent from the source.

rows.previous_en: No one has returned from their side.
rows.revised_en: Nor any enemy come from Anjy.
rows.note: The source says an enemy has not come from Анжы; the previous English omitted both enemy and place.
